steps.name: apply-and-format-stage18a-recovery
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=54693e57b0d736a5171b42dca88e45b595bbe94d; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage18/apply_stage18a_runtime_policy_modes.py > /tmp/apply-stage18a-runtime-policy-modes.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/apply-stage18a-runtime-policy-modes.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_runtime.py tests/test_climate_runtime.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff format tools/ml/climate_runtime.py tests/test_climate_runtime.py; git diff --check; git status --short
